sample_steps.operation: Read only the selected source form files and keep year and questionnaire form explicit. Retain the sampled seniors; do not add an exact-age, employment, race, gender or graduation filter absent further documentation.

Validate year/form variables using source metadata. Use year plus serial as a unique key. Keep the two forms as separate respondent samples; never inner-join Form 3 with Form 4 or append a duplicate core-file copy.
Select the fixed item list in variables. Decode user-missing and system-missing values before any valid-response or weight filtering; record exclusions by reason.
Apply the chosen AX01 eligibility rule separately for each descriptive item and each CFA model. In a weighted branch, additionally require valid positive V5 and record how many records are excluded.
Compute native item means, SDs and endorsement rates with explicit denominators. Use AX03 orientation only for the preliminary centrality CFA and named oriented outputs.
sample_steps.applies_to: item outputs and Form 3 preliminary CFA

sample_steps.operation: Fit preliminary Form 3 centrality plus manifest job-stability model and preliminary Form 4 seven-factor model. Evaluate internal consistency separately for each multi-item construct; do not data-select a new item list.
Fit the prespecified five-factor Form 4 model using the indicated memberships. Keep security and influence items in descriptive outputs but out of the final measurement model.

Fit configural, metric, full scalar, partial scalar and equal-latent-mean models across administration years in the stated nested sequence. Resolve AX04/AX05 before interpreting absolute latent means; do not search constraints by agreement with targets.

Output each year’s latent moments and covariance, all chronological pairwise contrasts, standardized contrasts under AX09, interval estimates and inference under AX10/AX11. Save actual eligible case counts separately for every output.

weights.rule: Not determined by article. AX06 origin uses public V5; normalize within each CFA group only as specified there. Summaries use sum(w*x)/sum(w). Always output unweighted eligible n and sum(w), never infer either from a target. Weight variance/SE interpretation must be explicit. Weighted SD and sampling-variance choices are explicitly AX13; these are not settled by normalization.

estimators.quantity: For each item and year: m=sum(w*x)/W, percentage=100*sum(w*I(endorsement))/W. Unweighted SD uses sum((x-m)^2)/(n-1). Provisional analytic-weight SD uses sum(w*(x-m)^2)/(W-sum(w^2)/W); this is an explicit convention, not a recovered native default. Missing weights are ineligible only in the weighted branch.
estimators.groups: Within each administration year and questionnaire form; never pool forms for one item.
estimators.software_default_notes: Descriptive software not named. Source items remain in native units. AX01, AX02 and AX06 apply. AX13 fixes the provisional weighted-variance convention.

estimators.quantity: For group g, x=nu_g+Lambda_g*eta+epsilon; E[x]=nu_g+Lambda_g*mu_g and Cov[x]=Lambda_g*Phi_g*Lambda_g^T+Theta_g. Simple item structure from constructs; provisional correlated factors and diagonal residual covariance. Normal-theory ML minimizes sum_g n_g[log|Sigma_g|+tr(S_g*Sigma_g^-1)+(m_g-model_m_g)^T*Sigma_g^-1*(m_g-model_m_g)-log|S_g|-p], with ML-normalized covariance inputs. Raw-data likelihood is an equivalent complete-case implementation. Full model syntax is unavailable; AX04/05/08/12 remain open.
estimators.groups: Separate-year preliminary models and the same three administration groups in the final multigroup model.
estimators.software_default_notes: LISREL 8.7 is named; fitting function, optimizer, tolerance, moment scaling, residual covariances and identification are not documented. No software default is silently treated as stated.

estimators.quantity: Metric model: constrain loadings equal across groups. Scalar model: additionally constrain item intercepts. Partial scalar model: free flagged-item intercepts under AX05; flagged variables are V4238, V4240, V4231, V4229, V4230, V4228. Equal-mean model: additionally constrain all final factor means across groups. Preserve nesting and the same analytic sample for differences.
estimators.software_default_notes: Use identical metric identification and sample for nested comparisons. A group-specific release matrix is not supplied; it must not be reverse-engineered from fit values.

estimators.quantity: Exact published standardization formula is unavailable. Provisional AX09.L0: d_ab=(mu_b-mu_a)/sqrt((Phi_a,kk+Phi_b,kk)/2). AX09.L1: d_ab=(mu_b-mu_a)/sqrt(((n_a-1)*Phi_a,kk+(n_b-1)*Phi_b,kk)/(n_a+n_b-2)). Both define positive as a higher latent mean in later year b. Do not substitute observed composite SDs without a documented conversion.
estimators.groups: All chronological year pairs, separately by final construct.
estimators.software_default_notes: No bias correction is described. Output raw latent contrast and the denominator used; do not infer denominator from numerical fit to targets.
estimators.unavailable_reason: Article calls the statistic d and change in SDs without defining the standardizer or its variance source.

estimators.quantity: Unweighted pooled t=(m_b-m_a)/(sp*sqrt(1/n_a+1/n_b)); sp^2=((n_a-1)*s_a^2+(n_b-1)*s_b^2)/(n_a+n_b-2), df=n_a+n_b-2. Welch alternative t=(m_b-m_a)/sqrt(s_a^2/n_a+s_b^2/n_b), df=(s_a^2/n_a+s_b^2/n_b)^2/[(s_a^2/n_a)^2/(n_a-1)+(s_b^2/n_b)^2/(n_b-1)]. These formulas are exact for the specified unweighted branches. Weighted tests require the AX06/AX07 variance convention to be supplied; do not treat weights as extra respondents. For the work-if-financially-comfortable item also output the explicitly named oriented contrast in 3-x, separate from native-coded means. In the provisional analytic-weight branch AX13.L0, set v_g=s_w,g^2*sum(w_g^2)/W_g^2 and use z=(m_b-m_a)/sqrt(v_a+v_b); label it approximate weighted Wald, not the unweighted t target. Original weighted-test df remain null until a documented rule is supplied.
estimators.groups: All chronological year pairs for each item; AX10 chooses the test.
estimators.software_default_notes: Printed test convention is incompletely documented; preserve both native and explicitly oriented output labels, not an ad hoc sign change.

estimators.quantity: Reliability diagnostic for k-item scales: alpha=k/(k-1)*(1-sum_j S_jj/(1^T*S*1)); define item covariance after stated reversals and missingness handling. Raw covariance alpha is provisional; no numeric reliability values are assumed.
estimators.groups: Per year and multi-item preliminary/final construct.
estimators.software_default_notes: Reliability computation and standardization are not specified. No reliability value is a manifest input. Raw versus standardized alpha is AX14.

inference.test: Nested chi-square differences for invariance; CFI decrement is CFI_less_constrained-CFI_more_constrained with the stated .002 decision criterion. Equality at the cutoff is not defined. Item tests are AX10. Provisional latent pairwise Wald z=(mu_b-mu_a)/sqrt(Var(mu_b)+Var(mu_a)-2*Cov(mu_a,mu_b)); AX11 also defines the alternative nested contrast test.
inference.se_method: Native model-based SEs from LISREL are described; information-matrix choice and robust options are unreported. AX07 governs unavailable survey-design covariance.
inference.tail: Unreported; provisional two-sided mean-contrast tests, upper-tail nested chi-square tests.
inference.alpha_reason: No universal testing alpha declared. Output 95% individual mean CIs, and star thresholds .05, .01, .001 as the table key specifies; provisional pairwise nominal alpha is in AX11.
inference.clustering: Multistage sampling; actual cluster/stratum identifiers unavailable in public source metadata. No clustering adjustment is documented. AX07.
inference.multiple_comparison: Not documented; AX11 origin is explicitly unadjusted and provisional.

outputs_required: Per item/year: actual valid unweighted count, weight sum, mean, SD, endorsement count and percentage with denominators, and missing-code/exclusion audit.
Per item/year pair: native-coded contrast, optional explicitly oriented binary contrast, t, df, SE, exact computed p, nominal tail and threshold, interval and chosen variance/weight convention.

Per model/year/group: eligible counts, input moments, loading/intercept/residual constraints, latent covariance, convergence diagnostics, chi-square, df, RMSEA, SRMSR, TLI, CFI and reliability diagnostics.
Per final construct/year: latent mean, latent SD with its definition, SE and 95% CI in a common identified scale; do not substitute item-average scores.
Per nested comparison: chi-square and df differences, calculated p and CFI decrement; retain full precision before display rounding.
Per final construct/year pair: latent contrast and full-covariance SE, chosen standardized contrast and denominator, interval, inference, and all chosen spec-space level IDs.
